name: Battle of Hillsbrad
summary: At Hillsbrad, the Forsaken campaign has broken the human township's defenses. High Executor Darthalia sends you to carry her commendation to Varimathras in the Undercity.

sections.title: A Decisive Campaign
sections.body: The fighting in Hillsbrad Foothills has been a brutal struggle for southern Lordaeron. From Tarren Mill, Horde champions struck at the township's farmers, militia, blacksmiths, and civic leaders. With Alliance forces crippled and the territory secured for the Forsaken, High Executor Darthalia prepares an official commendation so the champion's deeds reach the highest ranks of command.

sections.title: Audience with the Dreadlord
sections.body: Darthalia's sealed commendation takes you to Varimathras in the Undercity's Royal Quarter. The dreadlord oversees military operations across Lordaeron beside Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. The Scourge from the northern Plaguelands remains the Dark Lady's greatest threat, while surviving human enclaves still endanger the Forsaken's southern borders.

faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia sends you to deliver her sealed commendation to Varimathras in the Undercity, after the Forsaken campaign against Hillsbrad has broken the township's defenses.

faq.q: Where do I turn in Darthalia's Sealed Commendation?
faq.answer: Take Darthalia's Sealed Commendation to Varimathras in the Royal Quarter of the Undercity, where he stands beside Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: Why does Varimathras care about Hillsbrad?
faq.answer: Varimathras oversees military operations across Lordaeron. The Scourge in the north is the Undercity's greatest threat, but human settlements in the south harass Forsaken lines, so Hillsbrad's defeat protects the southern frontier.
High Executor Darthalia is the senior Forsaken commander at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. She directs the offensive against the nearby human settlement.

faq.q: Does this quest lead to further missions in Hillsbrad?
aliases: next quest after battle of hillsbrad
faq.answer: Delivering the commendation to Varimathras concludes the Battle of Hillsbrad storyline. Darthalia commends you for breaking the town's defenses.

faq.q: Why were the Forsaken attacking Hillsbrad in the first place?
faq.answer: Hillsbrad is one of the last organized human footholds in Lordaeron. Its Alliance militia and its proximity threaten Tarren Mill and the southern approaches to the Undercity.

angles.text: As an undead, you bring word of your victory over Hillsbrad's living to the Royal Quarter, earning praise and affirming your place in the Dark Lady's rising empire.
As a member of the Horde, you drive back Alliance forces in Lordaeron and secure vital ground for the Horde in the Eastern Kingdoms.
